main_text.p: De reducendo enim Hiscone diversis sententiis inter proceres contendebatur, Ea contentio usque eò exarsit, ut Coppeno Iarcæo duce, qui erat Sciringicarum partium princeps, & acerbus odii persecutor; naturaque turbidus & sævus, aliquos adversæ factionis proceres in curia, in foro, in domibus suis per tumultum sint interempti, reliqui eorundem partium magno numero, & in his viri nobiles consulari & senatoria dignitate, ejecti in exilium: exules ad Kenonem trans Amasuim sunt profecti, auxilii in inimicos communes spe. Sciringii civitate potiti, autore eodem Coppeno, domo egressi ex agro etiam æmulos, adversæ factionis homines ejecerunt. At biennio post, cùm flueret annus à Christo natum cccc xv, Keno Broecmerius assiduis exulum precibus exoratus, & ut suis quoque rebus contra Hiscônem & socios ejus Sciringios consuleret, exercitum clam confecit, captaque per insidias nocturnas urbe, & ejectis cum Coppeno factiosissimis quibusque Sciringicarum partium, exulibus & Vetcope-

page.notes: The text runs on to the next page; the word "Vetcope-" is hyphenated at the line end as printed. The "ns" at lower right is partly cut off and doubtful; it may be a catchword or a stray mark. The marginal note is printed in italics as "Groninga à Keno-ne capta". Long s was normalised to s; u/v spelling was normalised as instructed. The text "Hiscône" in the scan is printed as "Hiscone" with an acute-like mark possibly from the print. Check the word "Hiscone" against the scan if needed.
